verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is an API-backed compliance and case-management SaaS, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test environment, or isolation from production data. The docs cover only production APIs (Alerts, Case, import, filing), and validating cases against a jurisdiction is a different feature from an isolated sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
